titleRomaji: Seijo no Ane Desu ga, Imouto no Tame no Tokushu Maseki ya Tokushu Yakusou no Saishu wo Yametara, Ringoku no Majutsushi-sama no Moto de Shiawase ni Narimashita!
titleNative: 聖女の姉ですが、妹のための特殊魔石や特殊薬草の採取をやめたら、隣国の魔術師様の元で幸せになりました！
synopsis: The main character, a young girl named Sherry, is an excellent "gatherer" who collects special herbs and magic stones. She became a gatherer to help her only relative, her younger sister Irene, a saint, but when Irene comes of age and is engaged, she abandons her and tells her to disappear somewhere. Sherry decides to leave her country and heads for the neighboring Rogue Kingdom, where magic is thriving. Along the way, she meets Aslan, a handsome magician from the Rogue Kingdom... This is the Cinderella story of a gathering nerd who turns her life around. (Source: Natalie, translated)

title: Candy Candy
titleNative: キャンディ・キャンディ
synopsis: This story is about a girl, Candy, who is a orphan. She is a nice and optimistic girl and she has a warm heart. When she was a child, she lived in an orphanage called Pony's Home. She had a good friend called Annie. And she met the "Prince of the Hill" who is a important person in her life, on the hill behind the orphanage. She was adopted by the Leagan's family. What's awaiting her are the bad-hearted Neil and his sister, Eliza. One day, in the rose garden, she met a boy, who is identical to the "Prince of the Hill" who she had met in her childhood. The boy is called Anthony. Thereafter, a fantastic story that she has never expected begins. (Source: AnimeNfo) Note: Won the 1st Kodansha Manga Award for shoujo in 1977.

After losing his life in the joy of obtaining a rare material in a game, he is transported to another world by the power of God. In order to make life in the other world easier, Shu prays to God for the "power to gather materials at his own pace!" His wish is granted, but somehow the power is strangely strong and convenient!? In a different world full of unknown materials, Shu struggles to gather various materials in order to live a rich and relaxed life of gathering materials! (Source: Amazon Japan, translated)

title: How to Love a Loser
synopsis: Shinba has no talent, no job, no money...he's a complete loser. However, he has a girlfriend, Hizumi who is beautiful, smart, good at her work. He has no idea why she says she likes him. He's almost scared, but loves Hizumi so much...he asks Hizumi, "Why do you want to date with someone like me?" She answers..."You always oversleep, talk about some video games I don't even know about, sing lame songs no one knows at karaoke, gave me a toy ring as a gift. Your face is always gloomy as hell. But...looking at such face makes me happy, Shinba. I love you, ha ha." Is she telling the truth? Hizumi must have some kind of a secret, Shinba thinks. He wants to find out...but maybe he shouldn't. (Source: BookWalker)

synopsis: My peaceful school life... is officially over. Izumiya Ryouta, an introverted otaku, suddenly finds himself surrounded by the top three beauties of the class after a seat change. In front of him sits the little-sister-type Miyama Airi. To his left, the cool and detached gyaru, Ichinose Yuria. And to his right, the refined, black-haired class rep, Kuroki Ruri. On the surface, they're flawless beauties—but Ryouta stumbles upon secrets that none of them can ever let out... "P-Please...! Just don't tell anyone about this!" "From now on, we're in that kind of relationship." "This is a secret... just between you and me, Ryouta-kun." All he wanted was a quiet otaku life—so how did things end up like this?! Caught between three troublesome girls, an introverted otaku desperately fights to avoid any more chaos in this love-comedy showdown! (Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: NonNonBa
synonyms: Non Non Ba
Nonnonba
synopsis: Autobiographical tale in which Mizuki narrates the memories of his childhood in the decade of 1930, in Sakaiminato, a small coastal town at the southwest Japan. With nostalgia and tenderness, the mangaka narrates his first years of life within a modest family, the fights with his friends,the school and his first loves. The title character of the book, NonNonBa, is an old mystical and superstitious woman by which Shigeru discovers the world of yokai, supernatural beings and grotesque bestiary of medieval Japanese. Won Best Album at the 2007 Angoulême International Comics Festival.

title: Chanto Suki tte Ieruko Musou
titleNative: ちゃんと好きって言える子無双
synonyms: The Girl Who Can Clearly Say "I Love You" Is Unbeatable
synopsis: There's always just one surefire way to win in a romantic comedy—simply saying "I like you!" The girls who have feelings for high school boy Izumi spent their days unable to take that first step forward. [The School Idol Who Only Wants to Be Pampered When It's Just the Two of Them] Amane Amasaki. [Even Though I Was Disowned, My Former Fiancé Just Won't Leave Me Alone!] Hakua Shiragiku. [The Angel of the Academy... But the Devil Next to Her Is Surprisingly Easy] Haru Kasuga. However, transferring into their class is Nanao Nanase, a seemingly ordinary girl who is actually a natural-born main heroine! Nano starts her fierce assault on Izumi with her shameless and straightforward approach. "Izumi-kun, I like you. Please go out with me." "Here, say 'ahh'~♪" "Izumi-kun, you're the one who made me into this kind of girl, you know?" In a panic, Amane and the others can't help but spring into action—"This girl... She actually did it!?" (Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Mimi's Tales of Terror
synonyms: Mimi's Ghost Stories
Contos de Horror da Mimi
Les cauchemars de Mimi
Las historias de fantasmas de Mimi
synopsis: University student Mimi and her boyfriend Naoto encounter one chilling mystery after another. There’s the enigmatic neighbor woman dressed in black from head to toe—but if she’s so odd, why does it seems like there are many others like her? Then, whose eyes track Mimi’s movements from the cemetery next door? And why does a bizarre red circle drawn on a basement wall change with each passing day? Nine scary stories that really happened, drawn from the famed collection of urban legends Shin Mimibukuro (New Earmuffs), and adapted into manga by horror genius Junji Ito! Chapter 1: On the Utility Pole Chapter 2: The Woman Next Door Chapter 3: Rustling in the Grass Chapter 4: Grave Placement Chapter 5: Seashore Chapter 6: Just the Two of Us Chapter 7: Scarlet Circle Chapter 8: Sign in the Field Chapter 9: Monster Prop (Source: VIZ Media)
